source.motion_composition: Full local project: out/catalog-v040-motion/. Committed docs/media/motion-v0.4.0/ contains index.html, materials.md and treatment.md only; vendor runtime, fonts, recordings and frames are excluded.
source.composition_hash_scope: Git blob bytes of docs/media/motion-v0.4.0/index.html with LF newlines

capture.method: ZCode built-in In-app Browser (IAB) tab.recording (BrowserRecordingAPI start/status), recording the live huashu-motion GSAP composition
capture.note_recorder: recording.start requires a non-empty actions array (a keep-alive wait); maxDurationMs is a cap, not the requested length. The composition timeline was played (tl.play) from frame 0 after the recorder settled.
capture.en_variant: Separate recording of the same composition with ?lang=en. Seven captions change to English. Source frames, camera settings and timeline are shared; final recorded pixels and bytes differ.
capture.overlay: One opaque narration band and a huashu-motion signature during the final 1.2 seconds. A code camera reframes the captured UI without changing its controls or styles.
capture.note_recording_engine: no frame is synthesized: the film seeks a 10 fps PNG sequence decoded from the genuine 15 fps IAB recording (materials/frames), so every frame is a pure function of time

encoding.method: FFmpeg fps=5, scale=960:540 (lanczos), palettegen (max_colors=96, stats_mode=diff) + paletteuse (bayer dither)

outputs.language: zh captions over native zh UI
en captions over native zh UI (shared source frame sequence)

still_note: the six v0.4.0 stills were captured earlier from the same genuine catalog UI and are unchanged by this motion pass (native zh UI; zh and en stills are byte-identical). They are not re-rendered here.

claims.animated_preview_support: the catalog supports Skill-provided animated previews; the featured agent-skill-catalog entry shows one, sourced from this project's own promo clip
claims.image_provenance_captions_visible: detail gallery and card covers label provenance (Skill 自带图片 vs 自动生成封面)

verification.known_artifact: at the zoom scene the source recording's own baked-in bottom caption strip is briefly visible just above the composition's narration band (a faithful trace of the genuine capture, not a restyle); it does not crop or obscure key text.
